name: notebook_ops
description: Query and manage the Open Notebook research knowledge base. Use for external knowledge: RFCs, papers, API docs, web articles — anything NOT in the codebase. Falls back gracefully with {"available":false} when Open Notebook is not running (base stack without overlay).

action.description: Operation to perform. list_notebooks: list all notebooks. create_notebook: create a new notebook by name. search: full-text or vector search across notebook content. add_note: save text content as a permanent note. add_source_url: ingest a URL (article, doc, RFC) into a notebook.

notebook_id.description: Target notebook ID (SurrealDB record ID, e.g. 'notebook:abc123'). Required for search, add_note, add_source_url.

search_type.description: Search mode: vector=semantic similarity, text=keyword. Default: vector.

title.description: Title for add_note or add_source_url actions.

content.description: Text content to save as a note (for add_note action).

url.description: URL to ingest as a source (for add_source_url action).
